changelog.summary: Restore Network as a portable first-party Pi-hole Module with brokered credentials, v5/v6 compatibility, dual-instance resilience, and audited blocking controls.
entries: Preserve the Network Module ID, slug, configuration keys, permissions, Page path, and Widget IDs.
Support exact Pi-hole v6 session, summary, and DNS blocking routes plus legacy v5 admin/api.php commands.
Keep credentials opaque to Module code and inject them only inside NAD core's signed HTTP scopes.
Report partial dual-instance failures and verify the observed final state of every blocking mutation.

preserves: config keys pihole_url, pihole_api_key, pihole_api_version, pihole2_url, pihole2_api_key
